summary: Clarify whether 64/223 is an additional form parallel
rationale: The supplied 64/223 is “Lə gḏaʕ, mə soyəm, faš mḥayro” (he did not know what to do and was at a loss), not the quoted search-and-return-home sentence. That complete sentence is supplied under PrS 44/34, while the entry already cites prs 126/11. Since 64/223 does attest mḥayro and may intentionally be a form parallel, do not mechanically replace it with the automatic best match. Clarify the status of this secondary reference.
The German infinitive after “verunsichert” is “sein”; “sen” is a missing-letter typo.
The example specifies ten currency notes (ʕaṣro=noṭat); the German currency term contains Pfund, not Fund.
